definition.def: An initiative is an important act or statement that is intended to solve a problem.
examples: Government initiatives to help young people have been inadequate.
There's talk of a new peace initiative.

definition.def: In a fight or contest, if you have the initiative, you are in a better position than your opponents to decide what to do next.
examples: We have the initiative; we intend to keep it.
He paused enough to consider the options but never so long as to lose the initiative.

definition.def: If you have initiative, you have the ability to decide what to do next and to do it, without needing other people to tell you what to do.
examples: She was disappointed by his lack of initiative.
...workers who are able to sort out problems on their own initiative.

definition.def: If you take the initiative in a situation, you are the first person to act, and are therefore able to control the situation.
examples: We must take the initiative in the struggle to end the war.
She knew she had to take the initiative and maintain an aggressive game throughout.
